9999-ERROR-HANDLER has no GOBACK/STOP RUN: after logging an error it returns to the caller and processing continues. A failed OPEN therefore does not stop the program, and RETURN-CODE is never set.

If VALIDATION-CONTROL, POSITION-MASTER or TRANSACTION-HISTORY fails to open, 9999-ERROR-HANDLER writes ERROR-RECORD before ERROR-REPORT is opened (line 128); if ERROR-REPORT itself fails to open, the handler writes to the unopened file. The WRITE status is not checked.

END-OF-VALIDATION is set only by the AT END branch of READ VALIDATION-CONTROL. If the file failed to open (processing continues, see error_handler_returns) or a READ fails with a status other than end of file, neither AT END nor NOT AT END runs and the loop may not terminate. WS-VAL-STATUS is not tested in the loop.

WS-RECORDS-READ, WS-RECORDS-VALID, WS-TOTAL-AMOUNT, WS-CONTROL-TOTAL, WS-ERR-TYPE and WS-ERR-KEY are never set by traceable statements; ERROR-FOUND is set (line 188) but never tested; VAL-PARAMETERS is never used. Their use may be in the missing paragraphs.

program_narrative: Program UTLVAL00 is a batch data-validation utility driven by a control file. It opens VALIDATION-CONTROL, POSITION-MASTER and TRANSACTION-HISTORY for input and ERROR-REPORT for output, logging an error line for any file that fails to open, and clears its validation totals. It then reads VALIDATION-CONTROL sequentially until end of file; for each control record it selects a validation by VAL-TYPE: 'INTEGRITY' performs position and transaction integrity checks, 'XREF' cross-reference checks, 'FORMAT' format checks and 'BALANCE' position accumulation and balance verification; any other type is logged as 'INVALID VALIDATION TYPE'. The eight check paragraphs that do the actual work (2210-CHECK-POSITION-INTEGRITY through 2520-VERIFY-BALANCES) are not present in the source, so what is validated is unknown, and POSITION-MASTER and TRANSACTION-HISTORY are opened but never read by traceable code. Error handling adds 1 to the error count, sets the error flag and writes the error message to ERROR-REPORT, then returns to the caller; the program never stops on an error. Finally it closes all four files and returns.

paragraphs.name: 2100-PROCESS-VALIDATION
paragraphs.pseudocode_text:
SELECT CASE validation_type (VAL-TYPE)
  WHEN value of WS-INTEGRITY ('INTEGRITY'):
    CALL 2200-check-integrity
  WHEN value of WS-XREF ('XREF'):
    CALL 2300-check-xref
  WHEN value of WS-FORMAT ('FORMAT'):
    CALL 2400-check-format
  WHEN value of WS-BALANCE ('BALANCE'):
    CALL 2500-check-balance
  ELSE:
    SET error_message = 'INVALID VALIDATION TYPE'
    CALL 9999-error-handler
END SELECT

annotations.note: The WHEN objects are data items, not literals: VAL-TYPE is compared with the current contents of WS-INTEGRITY, WS-XREF, WS-FORMAT and WS-BALANCE (initial VALUEs 'INTEGRITY', 'XREF', 'FORMAT', 'BALANCE'; no statement changes them).
